newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians stage mock funeral for peace process.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians stage mock funeral for peace process.

text.p: Palestinians on Thursday staged a mock funeral in the West Bank for the peace process they said was killed by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, witnesses said.
They said about 150 Bethlehem University students marched through town carrying a black coffin with a dove and olive branch inscribed with the words "Killed by Netanyahu."
The funeral procession gave way to stone-throwing protests when demonstrators reached an Israeli military checkpoint on the northern outskirts of town.
Israeli soldiers fired teargas and rubber-coated metal bullets at the protesters but there were no reports of any injuries.
Demonstrators then set the coffin alight.

Israel ignited Palestinian protests last month when it broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem despite world opposition. three Palestinians have been killed by Israeli soldiers and scores wounded in 15 consecutive days of unrest.

Three Israeli women were killed by a Palestinian suicide bomber in a Tel Aviv cafe two weeks ago. The militant Islamic Jihad group on Thursday took responsibility for two botched suicide bomb attempts in Gaza on Tuesday.
